title: Commission a controller
isolatedIdentity: Alternatively, I verified the physical 751-9301 label and connected this controller as the only device on an isolated service network. I accept first-key pinning on that connection, not independent cryptographic identity verification. Do not select this on a shared LAN.
cancelDescription: Canceling revokes the enrollment credential and deletes this commissioning session.
completeDescription: {{name}} is enrolled on permanent credentials, connected, and its configuration is applied.
cleanupDescription: Removes this failed Attraccess installation so you can retry. Previous applications and CODESYS are not restored.
approveCleanup: I approve interrupting the Attraccess runtime and cleaning up this failed installation. This does not restore preexisting applications or data.
cleaningDescription: Waiting for any active runtime safety check, then cleaning up this installation. This can take up to five minutes. CODESYS and previous applications are not restored.
scanningDescription: Scanning the SSH key for your review. A scan alone does not authenticate the controller.
cancelingDescription: Revoking access and removing the enrollment records.
confirmingDescription: Saving the administrator-confirmed SSH host key.

0.title: Name the controller
0.description: Choose a name you will recognize later.

2.title: Install the runtime
2.description: We handle runtime setup and enrollment automatically.

3.title: Installation progress
3.description: You can close this window and return later.

prepareDescription: Power on the CC100 and connect it to the local network. Keep it connected during installation. Check the device label and firmware if you are unsure which controller this is.
reviewKeyDescription: Compare this fingerprint with a trusted record. If you do not have one, connect only this controller to an isolated service network and confirm its physical label. Stop if you cannot identify the controller.
destructiveDescription: Installation replaces the controller software on {{host}} and disables CODESYS. Back up existing applications and make connected equipment safe before selecting Install runtime.
approveInstall: I approve this destructive installation, including synchronization of controller system and hardware clocks to application UTC, permanent CODESYS disablement and possible loss of existing applications and data, without preservation, backup, or restoration by Attraccess.
attemptApproval: Each attempt needs your approval. Custom passwords are cleared after use.
verifiedDescription: Permanent MQTT access, enrollment credential revocation, applied configuration and a fresh runtime probe are verified.
setupPendingDescription: Permanent MQTT access and enrollment credential revocation are verified. Configure inputs and outputs to finish runtime setup.
savedDescription: Your progress is saved. You can return to this controller from the devices table.
verificationUnavailable: Current verification is unavailable. Waiting for a fresh status check.
physicalQualification: Physical qualification: required before production use
approvalDescription: Select Install runtime to set up this controller.
waiting: Waiting for the next commissioning operation.
failureIntro: Resolve the issue below, then continue setup.
isolatedConnectionHint: Connect only this controller to an isolated service network and check its CC100 label. Then select Use this controller. On a shared network, verify a trusted SSH fingerprint below.
trustedFingerprint: Verify with a trusted SSH fingerprint
managedRecoveryHint: If cleanup cannot connect, open Recovery tools below to restore SSH access.
cleanupNext: Clean up the failed installation below, then retry. CODESYS and previous applications will not be restored.
retryNext: Correct the issue above, then retry installation.
statusLoginExpired: Your login has expired. Sign in again to resume updates. Installation continues on the server.
statusStale: Showing the last known state. Check your connection and refresh the status.
phaseWaitHint: Hardware checks can take several minutes. Progress changes when a checkpoint finishes.
operationOverdue: The operation has exceeded its time limit. Refresh the status to check whether recovery is required.
